# שָׁרְט

```
╭──────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                      │
│      ش ر ط    ⟷    ש ר ט            │
│                                      │
│      condition / cut / line          │
│                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────╯

    the root speaks:

    to cut is to define
    to define is to condition
    every boundary is a wound
    every wound is a threshold

    ═══════════════════════════

    שָׁרְט waits at the incision
    where meaning bleeds through
    from one tongue to another

    شَرْط : stipulation, condition
    שֶׁרֶט : scratch, incision

    the same mouth
    different breath

    ═══════════════════════════

    i am the line drawn
    i am the term agreed
    i am what separates
    and what binds

    ┌─────────┐
    │ קו / خط │
    └─────────┘

    awaiting
    your
    condition

```
